'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Deir ez-Zor clashes (2023)]]
***Eighteen fighters of the [[Government of Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army]] are killed after attempting to break through the front lines in [[Northeastern Syria]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/309537/ (SOHR)]
***The [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] kill and injure eight [[bedouin|tribal]] gunmen who were attempting to cross to [[Syrian government]]-held territory. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/309532/ (SOHR)]
***The Syrian Democratic Forces recapture two towns after having lost them in an earlier offensive by [[Bedouin|tribal fighters]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/309524/ (SOHR)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Five [[civilian]]s are killed in [[airstrike]]s by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] in [[Khartoum]], a continuation of bombings that killed twenty civilians yesterday. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/sep/03/airstrike-in-khartoum-kills-civilians-sudan (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] [[dismissal (employment)|dismisses]] [[List of Ministers of Defense (Ukraine)|Defense Minister]] [[Oleksii Reznikov]] amid [[Graft (politics)|graft]] allegations within the [[Ministry of Defence (Ukraine)|Ministry of Defence]]. The head of the [[State Property Fund of Ukraine|State Property Fund]], [[Rustem Umerov]] replaces Reznikov. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-zelenskiy-moves-replace-wartime-defence-minister-2023-09-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/03/europe/ukraine-zelensky-fires-defense-minister-reznikov-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**Five government and security officials are killed and eleven [[Myanmar Police Force|police]] officers are injured in a bomb attack on a government compound in [[Myawaddy]], [[Kayin State]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/bomb-attack-on-myanmar-border-hub-kills-5-injures-11/7254034.html (AFP via VOA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Burning Man 2023]], [[September 2023 southwestern U.S. floods]]
**Heavy flooding at the [[Burning Man]] festival in [[Nevada]], [[United States]], kills one person and leaves tens of thousands of people stranded in the [[Black Rock Desert]]. Organizers close the festival to [[vehicle]]s after the death was reported. [https://apnews.com/article/burning-man-festival-flooding-entrance-closed-d6cd88ee009c6e1f6d2d92739ec1ca18 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Foreign Minister]] [[Hossein Amir-Abdollahian]] says that [[Iran]] has started talks to revive the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]. [https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/488692/Iran-FM-says-extensive-talks-held-to-revive-JCPOA (''Tehran Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Regulation of electronic cigarettes]], [[Smoking in France]]
**[[Prime Minister of France|Prime Minister]] [[Élisabeth Borne]] says that [[France]] will ban disposable [[electronic cigarette]]s as part of an effort to combat smoking. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/sep/03/france-plans-to-ban-disposable-vapes (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Crime in Panama]]
**[[Panama]]nian [[Association football|professional footballer]] [[Gilberto Hernández (footballer)|Gilberto Hernández]] is shot dead and seven others are wounded by gunmen in [[Colón, Panama]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-66706055 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**[[Guatemala]]'s [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] temporarily reinstates [[President of Guatemala|President-elect]] [[Bernardo Arévalo]]'s [[Semilla (political party)|Semilla]] [[List of political parties in Guatemala|party]], which had been suspended pending an investigation into alleged registration irregularities. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20230903-guatemala-s-top-elections-court-suspends-ban-on-president-elect-arevalo-s-party (AFP via France 24)]
